name: How to Set Up Your New Product
description: Step-by-step guide to setting up and configuring your new purchase

step.name: Unpack the product
step.text: Carefully remove the product from its packaging and check all components are included

step.name: Connect power
step.text: Plug the power cable into the device and connect to a power outlet

step.name: Initial configuration
step.text: Follow the on-screen instructions to complete the initial setup
